title: shorea submontana
intro: Shorea submontana, commonly known as Mountain White Oak, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae native to Borneo. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various conditions like wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Shorea submontana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant and cytotoxic activities. The bioactive compounds present in this plant have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential candidate for the development of new medicines.
